step29Context.comparison: STEP 29 = C (GLORYS + Stokes) vs B (GLORYS), alpha 0.002; frozen

summary.question: Does the already-computed GLORYS12V1 + Stokes drift candidate produce lower observed-versus-model trajectory error than the frozen HYCOM baseline? (final-candidate benchmark; not optimization, tuning, forcing or alpha selection)
summary.answer72h: Under the preregistered 72 h paired M3 rule the overall label is NO_CLEAR_DESCRIPTIVE_DIFFERENCE (median delta -4.244 km, wins/losses/ties 19/14/0).
statements: STEP 30A is a descriptive paired benchmark of two already-computed trajectory sets; no statistical significance, causal, universal or operational claim is made.
STEP 29 (GLORYS + Stokes vs GLORYS) and STEP 30A (GLORYS + Stokes vs HYCOM) are different comparisons and are never interchanged.
alpha = 0.002, Stokes coefficient 1.0, GLORYS depth 15.810070 m and HYCOM depth 15.000 m are unchanged; no alpha, coefficient, depth or forcing selection was made; MODEL_RUN_COUNT = 0.
Holdout results are descriptive only; the candidate was fixed before this step; no re-ranking, no selective rerun, no outlier handling.
AVISO and any other field are reference fields, not ground truth; STEP 17-29 results are unchanged.
STEP 30A overall 72 h: candidate median 44.652 km, HYCOM median 48.81 km, paired median delta -4.244 km, W/L/T 19/14/0, label NO_CLEAR_DESCRIPTIVE_DIFFERENCE.
Holdout (KE-H1, KE-H3) 72 h: median delta 0.881 km, W/L/T 6/6/0, descriptive label NO_CLEAR_DESCRIPTIVE_DIFFERENCE; not used for any selection.
STEP 29 context (C vs B, frozen): 72 h median delta -3.496 km, W/L 19/14; holdout -3.832 km, W/L 8/4. This is a different comparison from STEP 30A (C vs A).
